title: pyqpanda-algorithm runtime qualification manifest
description: Closed manifest schema attesting that a release candidate commit and wheel passed the fixed runtime qualification cases on one explicit device. Unknown keys are rejected at every level.

version.description: Schema version of this manifest structure.

timestamp.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp of manifest creation.

git_commit.description: Full 40-character SHA-1 of the qualified commit.

wheel.description: Wheel filename of the release candidate.

wheel_sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the candidate wheel file.

python_version.description: Python version of the qualification environment.

pyqpanda3_version.description: pyqpanda3 package version of the qualification environment.

qpanda3_runtime_version.description: qpanda3-runtime package version of the qualification environment.

chip_id.description: Explicitly selected device identifier, e.g. WK_C180.

summary.description: Human-readable device summary recorded from the service.

algorithm.description: Name of the qualified algorithm case.

execution_mode.description: Execution mode of this case, e.g. qpu or fake.

task_ids.description: Remote task identifiers submitted for this case; empty for circuit-only records.

threshold.description: Fixed statistical threshold committed before QPU execution.

raw_result_digest.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the recorded result evidence: the parsed-result record that enters the manifest on the QPU path (raw service responses are never retained), the raw result on the preflight path. The evidence itself is never stored.

parsed_result.description: Digestable interpretation of the raw result; shape is algorithm-specific.

verdict.description: Outcome against the fixed threshold; a device outage can never become passed.

transpiled.description: Whether the case circuit was successfully transpiled for the selected device.
